title: Moss, Fern, and Clover in Family Tree 1.1.0
description: Export of the family produced by vanilla breeding in an automated demonstration scene. Moss remains after a real death event.

title: Vanilla breeding, recorded family, and PNG export
description: 20 seconds in Minecraft 26.2 with Family Tree 1.1.0. An automated scene uses vanilla feeding, AI breeding, a real death event, and the actual network snapshot.

title: Horse breeding stats in an exported family
description: Comet and Dusk produced Ember through vanilla feeding and AI breeding in an automated scene in Minecraft 26.3. Each card shows speed, jump height, and health. A red triangle marks a stat lower than both parents.

title: Compare a foal with its parents
description: The same automated scene in the tree screen. Ember's panel lists each stat beside both parents' values, in blocks per second, blocks, and hearts.

title: The actual puppy's parents in 1.1.0
description: Clover's tree after vanilla breeding. Refresh, Add parents, and Open folder are available in the tree.

title: Add known parents without commands
description: Choose two pets in the picker, review the selection, and confirm. This screen uses a staged example family.

title: Find existing pets and get started in 1.1.0
description: A staged example in the browser, with search, status filters, Getting started, and Refresh.

title: Farm animals in the family tree
description: A pink lamb and its red and white parents, exported as a PNG. In an automated scene in Minecraft 26.3, the player named the sheep with name tags and fed them wheat, and vanilla AI bred the lamb.

title: A gold star for rare variants
description: Blue axolotls, brown mooshrooms, and brown pandas get a gold star. This axolotl was spawned blue in an automated scene and recorded with a name tag; it was not bred.

title: Plan a foal before you breed
description: The breeding planner for Quill and Sorrel, two horses bred by vanilla AI in an automated scene in Minecraft 26.3. It names them half siblings, gives the foal's inbreeding coefficient, and lists each stat's lowest, most likely, and highest value with the chance to beat both parents, plus coat and marking odds.

title: Compare two horses, plan their foal, and find the best pairs
description: 9 seconds in Minecraft 26.3. Shift-click highlights how Quill and Sorrel are related, Plan breeding opens their foal's odds, and Best pairs ranks 24 horses bred over four generations by vanilla AI in an automated scene.
